# Salesforce Releases Page — captured 2026-07-06

## Note
Direct fetch of https://www.salesforce.com/releases/ returned HTTP 403 on 2026-07-06
(consistent with 07-04, 07-03, 06-16, and earlier). Content below sourced via WebSearch
fallback for Summer '26 release notes.

## Content (Summer '26 — released ~June 2026, "Agentic Enterprise")
- Multi-Agent Orchestration — GA Jun 15 2026. A primary agent coordinates a team of
  specialized subagents, holds shared context, routes each request to best-fit specialist.
  Powered by Atlas Reasoning Engine 3.0 (reads subagent descriptions/instructions/actions
  to route, no fixed decision trees).
- Agent2Agent (A2A) open protocol — primary agent can delegate to third-party agents on
  other platforms.
- Agent Script + new Agentforce Builder — now GA.
- "Create Agent" element in Flow Builder — build/deploy agents directly on the flow canvas;
  legacy AI Agent actions auto-convert.
- IT Service Domain Pack — 50+ prebuilt AI agents for Slack, Teams, IT Service Desk.
- Agentforce Sales in Slack — proactive prospecting/engagement agents; Momentum captures
  calls/emails/meetings back to CRM.

## Prior (Spring '26, from 2026-03-25 fetch)
Agentforce Voice, Field Service proactive ops, Sales/Service/Marketing/Commerce/Platform.
